title: Corruption Behind The Locked Door - Devious HFO
description:
You’ve heard about the locked door. Now it opens.

Since your first session with Dr. Amethyst, one question has followed you through September’s experiment: what happens behind that door?

The public sessions introduced you to My world. Private Evaluation — Earning Entry brought you to the threshold.

Now comes the chapter you’ve been waiting for.

Corruption Behind The Locked Door - Devious HFO
Corruption Behind The Locked Door — Devious HFO is September’s centerpiece for the $50 Amethyst Collective tier ... the continuation of the story I’ve been building with you all month.

If the evaluation left you wondering what happens next, this is where you find out. The corridor, the questions, the anticipation: they’ve been leading here. And I’m keeping the details behind the door.

Joining the Collective also opens access to My private AmethystCollective.net experience, with its exclusive regularly rotating streaming sessions, and additional member-only audio releases. Select recordings return from the vault for limited appearances, giving you more to explore beyond this month’s experiment.

You’ve followed the story this far. Come discover the chapter reserved for the Collective.
author: Mistress Amethyst
